name: hero
description: Fills the viewport's height with copy on one side and a figure on the other, centered, and stacks them below a container width; the one-class form of a cover holding columns.

attributes.name: data-threshold
attributes.description: The container width below which copy and figure become rows.

attributes.name: data-align
attributes.description: Vertical alignment of copy and figure when side by side.

attributes.name: data-side
attributes.description: Put the figure at the start or the end of the row regardless of source order. Once stacked, source order rules: write the copy first to meet the headline first on a phone. Moves it visually only; reading order stays as written.

attributes.name: data-height
attributes.description: The band's least height: a stop of the height scale, half the viewport, or the whole of it, as a cover takes it. Content taller than the band grows it.

children.description: Exactly two: the copy and the figure (an img, video, or picture, or an element wrapping one); the copy (the body) must not have an img, video, or picture as a direct child (it would be taken for a second figure). A figure with a figcaption keeps its caption below the picture.
A child that takes several shares of the row: data-span="3" beside a "2" is three fifths. Below the threshold both stack full width.

markers.name: data-min
markers.description: The narrowest this child may get while the two share a row; the other gives way. Stacked, it has no effect.

markers.name: data-span
markers.description: How many shares of the row this child takes; the other child's default is 1.

tokens.name: --yeti-cover-height
tokens.description: The least height with no data-height, and at data-height="full".

tokens.name: --yeti-space-sm
tokens.description: The gap between the copy's children.

a11y.notes: When the hero is the page's opening, keep the h1 inside the copy and write the copy first: data-side changes where the figure sits in the row, not where it is read, and not the stacked order.
